This maize plot is small, only about a quarter hectare, and it is not my own land — I rent it, so I will not put too much money into it. I went to school a little, so I know fertilizer helps maize, and last season my neighbour got a better harvest with NPK, so I will try to buy half a bag of NPK 15-15-15 and maybe a little urea if cash allows — my husband sold a goat so there is some money. I will use the improved maize seed the agro-dealer sells because on this small plot the local seed does not give enough, and I will weed with my hoe myself with my two older children. No irrigation here, we wait for the rains in June, and I cannot afford pesticide — I will just pick off the stem borer by hand if I see it.
